import numpy as np
from types import SimpleNamespace
from scirel.sampling import get_fieldlines
p=np.array([[0.,0.],[0.,1.],[1.,1.],[1.,0.]])
c=SimpleNamespace(levels=[.2],allsegs=[[p]])
assert get_fieldlines(c,.2).shape==(4,2)
